notes: The positive branch is not a pure exponential — the ratio f(x+1)/f(x) drifts (≈2.66 near x=2, ≈1.28 near x=15, then rising again at large x). I replaced it with a fit of the form f(x) = -A·b^x·x^p, which captures the drift in local growth factor across the whole range, fitted by least squares to all the positive-branch data in the notebook.
